screenshots.alt: You choose the text, and where it is read. Selected text, the visible article or a paste. Then pick the full check on this device, the optional private EU route, or quick checks only. Nothing runs until you say so.
screenshots.caption: Choose the exact text, then choose where it is read. Nothing runs until you decide.

screenshots.alt: One clear reading, with every section scored. A five-band dial, the level in plain words and a score bar for every section in document order. The score is a zero-to-one pattern reading, never a percentage of AI text.
screenshots.caption: A five-band reading, the level in plain words and a score for every section.

screenshots.alt: The passage the model read, in your own words. Each section shows its exact passage and one measured signal: how often key words carry over between neighbouring sentences. Editing advice appears when the writing rules have any, and never counts towards the reading.
screenshots.caption: Every section shows its own passage, one measured signal and editing advice.

screenshots.alt: Every check named, and what the result does not mean. Three separate readings, every method with its status, version and limits, and a plain statement that no result proves who wrote a text.
screenshots.caption: Every named check, its status and limits, and what the result does not mean.

screenshots.alt: Branded reports, content-free receipts, file credentials. Save a branded PDF or the complete HTML report, copy a share line that carries none of your draft, and inspect a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF for Content Credentials on this device.
